compiler.name: AMD Vitis HLS
compiler.evidence: Coroni Vitis HLS 2021.1 identity and authenticated 2026-11-05 GAN/Kalman diagnostics

limit_interpretation.dim_zero_partial_factor: factor must not exceed any selected dimension extent
limit_interpretation.nonzero_dimension: extent of the selected source dimension; other dimensions remain array dimensions
limit_interpretation.boundary: reject complete partition only when selected partitioned element count is greater than 1024
limit_interpretation.confidence: conservative compiler-specific guard; exact internal XFORM accounting for multidimensional arrays remains subject to the prepared compiler probe

partial_partition_rule: block/cyclic factor must be positive and no larger than each selected dimension extent; factors need not be powers of two or divisors
source_tuple_rule: array type, factor sentinel, and dimension must extend to one complete SourceAction tuple under Vitis 2021.1 dim semantics

evidence.observation: Vitis 2021.1 rejected explicit complete partitioning of one-dimensional 262144-element Kalman arrays and reported threshold 1024 under the recorded runner configuration
Vitis 2021.1 rejected block factor 64 for GAN layer_2_out with source extent 50
UG1399 documents that dim=0 partitions all dimensions, any nonzero dimension selects one dimension, and complete partitioning omits factor
UG1448 identifies complete partitioning arrays larger than 1024 as a long-runtime risk; this is guidance, not a universal silicon/resource limit

limitations: The 1024 guard is specific to the authenticated Vitis 2021.1 runner profile and its observed XFORM diagnostic; it is not a universal FPGA capacity limit.
The exact internal 2021.1 XFORM counting behavior for multidimensional arrays is not established by UG1399 and requires the prepared compiler probe.
The config_array_partition complete_threshold setting describes automatic partitioning and is not treated as changing the explicit-directive XFORM rejection boundary.
This policy prevents known invalid choices; it does not guarantee HLS success, resource-budget feasibility, or timing closure.
